problems: Year overlaps at hand-overs: french-mandate-for-syria-and-lebanon ends 1946-04 where second-syrian-republic opens, kingdom-of-egypt ends 1953-06 where the Republic of Egypt opens, and pahlavi-dynasty ends 1979-02 where islamic-republic-of-iran opens; these are dissolve-and-found within one year, not overlaps of land.

Cliopatria's USSR 1946 shape still holds northern Iran and its British Colonial Empire 1942-45 shape holds south-western Iran (1,161 and 675 cells); the Pahlavi 1942-45 and 1946 shapes cut these out, so the Pahlavi keyframes were replaced by the full outline and the Allied zones are written as occupation events.

Wikidata Q139708 is shared between french-mandate-for-syria-and-lebanon and lebanon but they are different states: the Mandate is French-ruled Syria and Lebanon 1920-1946, the lebanon dossier opens 1943-11 as the independent republic.

Cliopatria keeps Kingdom of Hejaz and Nejd to 1935 while the state became Saudi Arabia in 1932-09; the dossier ends 1932-09 and the 1932 shape also carries 126 cells of the North Yemen 1931 shape (Najran).
Egypt is inside the British Africa shape to 1921 and Cliopatria draws no Sudan as Egyptian land; sultanate-of-egypt was added and the Sudan is not drawn as Egyptian in kingdom-of-egypt.

Cliopatria's 'Palestinians' 1948 row is the West Bank, not Gaza; the Gaza cell was removed from the Kingdom of Egypt 1948 and 1950 keyframes and Gaza is written as a vassal (all-palestine-government).
The 1971 Greater and Lesser Tunbs gain region and the Tunbs war zone in pahlavi-dynasty resolve to no cells (islands absent from the gazetteer); two resolve warnings remain.

pahlavi-dynasty war 0 (Sheikh Khazal rebellion, 1924) lies outside the dossier life 1925..1979 (validator warning); it was fought under Reza Khan before the dynasty began and is kept as listed on the Reza Shah page.

Open-ended relations by design (validator warnings): kingdom-of-egypt British Canal Zone occupation and Gaza vassal; republic-of-turkey northern Cyprus occupation, TRNC vassal and three Syrian occupations (2016-08, 2018-01, 2019-10) run to the dossier end.

Turkey area ratio: infobox 783,562 km2 against about 768k km2 in the Cliopatria shape (0.97-0.98); Egypt infobox 994,000 km2 (1937) against 1,005,709 (1.01); the Mandate, Pahlavi and Hejaz and Nejd pages give no area, so no ratio could be checked.
